requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement is linguistically clear but structurally mixes a functional action (inform) with a quality trigger (detection of damage). Per Pohl §25.2, it is decomposed into a functional requirement (informing the service) and a quality requirement (detection capability).

source_fragments: the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: the detector detects damage to the pane

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the detector detects damage to the pane, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Detection condition preserved as trigger.

source_fragments: the detector detects damage to the pane

fields.condition: when damage to the pane occurs
fields.measurable_criterion: ability to detect damage to the pane

structured_requirements.final_statement: The detector shall be capable of detecting damage to the pane.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (detection capability) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
